description: This file is a Perl test script using Test2::V0 and Test::Coocook modules to perform functional testing of a web application's organization lifecycle features, including creation, deletion, role management, and ownership transfer.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing class providing methods to simulate user interactions with the web application, such as navigation, form submission, and validation.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs a GET request and checks for success.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password, asserting success.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link identified by link text, asserting success.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Retrieves the current URI of the page.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields, asserting success.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Checks that the HTTP status code matches the expected value.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Accesses the database schema for querying.

methods.name: resultset
methods.description: Retrieves a result set for a specific table or view.

methods.name: text_lacks
methods.description: Asserts that the specified text is not present in the page content.

methods.name: text_contains
methods.description: Asserts that the specified text is present in the page content.

methods.name: content_lacks
methods.description: Asserts that the page content does not contain the specified string.
